sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP diet trial (hydrolysed soy), during which chicken appears on 29 of 154 meals and treats: Dentastix (label lists chicken) daily from Jun 8, on the owner-entered allowed list, and at least 4 off-list, the last on Jun 27.
No chicken-free day is recorded since Jun 8.

Itching was entered 16 times on 16 of 43 logged days, over at least 35 days, and this is not a test of the diet: Apoquel (doses not logged), NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlap the trial.
The owner wrote “flare after the chicken on Sunday” on Jun 18, Sunday being Jun 14; this is not tested, as chicken was fed daily from Jun 8.
Whether Apoquel was given is unknown.
